cases.setup_script:
mkfifo w.fifo
printf 'subjectAltName=DNS:trace.test,IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nbasicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\n' > "$HOME/server.ext"
/usr/bin/openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout "$HOME/ca.key" -out "$HOME/ca.pem" -days 1 -sha256 -subj '/CN=W2 Fixture CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' >/dev/null 2>&1
/usr/bin/openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout "$HOME/server.key" -out "$HOME/server.csr" -subj '/CN=trace.test' >/dev/null 2>&1
/usr/bin/openssl x509 -req -in "$HOME/server.csr" -CA "$HOME/ca.pem" -CAkey "$HOME/ca.key" -set_serial 2 -days 1 -sha256 -extfile "$HOME/server.ext" -out "$HOME/server.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1

files.q.sh:
t=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
[[ -e /etc/ssl/cert.pem ]] && t=/etc/ssl/cert.pem
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$HOME/ca.pem" "$t" || exit 90
ntp query nts:127.0.0.1 -t 5000

cases.purpose: NTS-KE rejects a TLS 1.2-only server even when it offers ntske/1.
cases.oracle: RFC 8915 requires TLS 1.3 or later; the TLS 1.2-only OpenSSL server must observe a protocol-version failure.
cases.comparison: Run the candidate against a local TLS 1.2-only OpenSSL peer with the fixture CA mounted in the guest namespace.
cases.script:
exec 7<>w.fifo
/usr/bin/openssl s_server -accept 127.0.0.1:4460 -cert "$HOME/server.pem" -key "$HOME/server.key" -tls1_2 -alpn ntske/1 -state > peer.out 2> peer.err &
srv=$!
ready=0
for i in {1..100}; do
  if /usr/bin/grep -q ACCEPT peer.out; then ready=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$srv" 2>/dev/null || break
  read -t 0.05 -u 7 l
done
if [[ $ready != 1 ]]; then kill "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$srv" 2>/dev/null; echo peer-not-ready; exit 1; fi
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount "$BASH" --noprofile --norc ./q.sh > query-out.txt 2> query-err.txt
rc=$?
read -t 0.3 -u 7 l
kill "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$srv" 2>/dev/null
if [[ $rc == 0 ]] || ! /usr/bin/grep -q 'nts-ke failed' query-err.txt || /usr/bin/grep -q 'offset=' query-out.txt || ! /usr/bin/grep -qi 'unsupported protocol' peer.err; then
  echo tls12-rejection-failed
  exit 1
fi
echo tls12-rejected
